invalid_preflight.reason: Reusing one Cargo target across two archived source directories incorrectly reused the software binary for initial hardware preflight; equal binary hashes detected. That hardware-labelled preflight is excluded, archived separately; hardware rebuilt with its own target before all valid VA measurements.

limitations: All numbers instrumented; user load varies strongly, no cross-round absolute improvement claim.
Snapshot copy and conversion optimizations did not yield a deployable total-chain improvement; prototypes only.
Kernel signal timestamp is fence status completion, not a hardware execution duration or per-engine trace.
Already signaled/retired fences (including old stub timestamps) are counted separately, not interpreted as thread wake delays.
VA mapping span includes caller work; VA API wall time does not separately measure physical DMA.
GStreamer may allocate conversion output in VA memory; upload can happen before encoder sink pad.
Four-byte source snapshots retained, resolution/bitrate/QP/GOP unchanged; hardware CPU NV12 variant passed existing decoded quality/lease regression.
Device-wide perf counters unavailable at perf_event_paranoid=4; no permission, power, clock, driver or production service settings changed.
No buffer-sharing implementation; no zero-copy claim; no remote input-to-display measurement.
